ledger_accounts_owner.name: ledger_accounts_owner
ledger_accounts_owner.value: ("ledger_accounts"."owner_type" = 'user' AND "ledger_accounts"."user_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("ledger_accounts"."owner_type" = 'house' AND "ledger_accounts"."user_id" IS NULL)

bets_settled_amounts.name: bets_settled_amounts
bets_settled_amounts.value: ("bets"."status" NOT IN ('won', 'lost', 'void', 'cashed_out') OR ("bets"."settled_gross_payout" IS NOT NULL AND "bets"."settled_tax" IS NOT NULL AND "bets"."settled_net_payout" IS NOT NULL AND "bets"."settled_at" IS NOT NULL)) AND ("bets"."status" NOT IN ('pending_acceptance', 'open', 'rejected') OR ("bets"."settled_gross_payout" IS NULL AND "bets"."settled_tax" IS NULL AND "bets"."settled_net_payout" IS NULL))

payment_intents_poll_idx.name: payment_intents_poll_idx
payment_intents_poll_idx.where: "payment_intents"."status" IN ('pending', 'expired') AND "payment_intents"."flagged_at" IS NULL AND "payment_intents"."provider_ref" IS NOT NULL

payouts_manual_four_eyes.name: payouts_manual_four_eyes
payouts_manual_four_eyes.value: ("payouts"."paying_by" IS NULL OR "payouts"."approved_by" IS NULL OR "payouts"."paying_by" <> "payouts"."approved_by") AND ("payouts"."settled_by" IS NULL OR "payouts"."approved_by" IS NULL OR "payouts"."settled_by" <> "payouts"."approved_by")

payouts_manual_destination.name: payouts_manual_destination
payouts_manual_destination.value: NOT "payouts"."manual" OR ("payouts"."destination_institution" IS NOT NULL AND "payouts"."destination_account" IS NOT NULL AND "payouts"."payout_account_id" IS NOT NULL)

payouts_manual_paid.name: payouts_manual_paid
payouts_manual_paid.value: NOT "payouts"."manual" OR "payouts"."status" <> 'paid' OR ("payouts"."settled_by" IS NOT NULL AND "payouts"."settlement_reference" IS NOT NULL)

jackpot_entries_prize.name: jackpot_entries_prize
jackpot_entries_prize.value: ("jackpot_entries"."status" = 'open' AND "jackpot_entries"."prize_gross" IS NULL AND "jackpot_entries"."prize_tax" IS NULL AND "jackpot_entries"."prize_net" IS NULL) OR ("jackpot_entries"."status" <> 'open' AND "jackpot_entries"."prize_tax" >= 0 AND "jackpot_entries"."prize_net" >= 0 AND "jackpot_entries"."prize_gross" = "jackpot_entries"."prize_net" + "jackpot_entries"."prize_tax")

jackpot_entries_correct.name: jackpot_entries_correct
jackpot_entries_correct.value: ("jackpot_entries"."status" IN ('won', 'lost')) = ("jackpot_entries"."correct" IS NOT NULL AND "jackpot_entries"."best_correct" IS NOT NULL)

jackpot_rounds_final.name: jackpot_rounds_final
jackpot_rounds_final.value: ("jackpot_rounds"."status" IN ('settled', 'cancelled')) = ("jackpot_rounds"."settled_at" IS NOT NULL AND "jackpot_rounds"."settlement" IS NOT NULL)

market_family_state_moved.name: market_family_state_moved
market_family_state_moved.value: "market_family_state"."status" = 'active' OR ("market_family_state"."raised_margin_bps" IS NOT NULL AND "market_family_state"."since_week" IS NOT NULL)

scrape_board_odds_teams_differ.name: scrape_board_odds_teams_differ
scrape_board_odds_teams_differ.value: "scrape_board_odds"."home_team_id" IS NULL OR "scrape_board_odds"."away_team_id" IS NULL OR "scrape_board_odds"."home_team_id" <> "scrape_board_odds"."away_team_id"

scrape_board_results_scores.name: scrape_board_results_scores
scrape_board_results_scores.value: "scrape_board_results"."home" BETWEEN 0 AND 99 AND "scrape_board_results"."away" BETWEEN 0 AND 99 AND ("scrape_board_results"."ht_home" IS NULL OR "scrape_board_results"."ht_home" BETWEEN 0 AND "scrape_board_results"."home") AND ("scrape_board_results"."ht_away" IS NULL OR "scrape_board_results"."ht_away" BETWEEN 0 AND "scrape_board_results"."away")

scrape_close_prices_ppm_range.name: scrape_close_prices_ppm_range
scrape_close_prices_ppm_range.value: ("scrape_close_prices"."consensus_ppm" IS NULL OR "scrape_close_prices"."consensus_ppm" BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000) AND ("scrape_close_prices"."pinnacle_ppm" IS NULL OR "scrape_close_prices"."pinnacle_ppm" BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000)

scrape_ladder_shadow_action.name: scrape_ladder_shadow_action
scrape_ladder_shadow_action.value: ("scrape_ladder_shadow"."action" = 'apply' AND "scrape_ladder_shadow"."rung" IN ('B', 'C') AND "scrape_ladder_shadow"."score" IS NOT NULL) OR ("scrape_ladder_shadow"."action" = 'void' AND "scrape_ladder_shadow"."rung" = 'D' AND "scrape_ladder_shadow"."strict" IS NOT NULL)

scrape_market_odds_market_selection.name: scrape_market_odds_market_selection
scrape_market_odds_market_selection.value: ("scrape_market_odds"."market" = '1x2' AND "scrape_market_odds"."selection" IN ('1', 'X', '2') AND "scrape_market_odds"."line" IS NULL) OR ("scrape_market_odds"."market" = 'ou' AND "scrape_market_odds"."selection" IN ('over', 'under') AND "scrape_market_odds"."line" IS NOT NULL AND "scrape_market_odds"."line" ~ '^[0-9]{1,2}(\.[0-9]{1,2})?$')

scrape_market_odds_teams_differ.name: scrape_market_odds_teams_differ
scrape_market_odds_teams_differ.value: "scrape_market_odds"."home_team_id" IS NULL OR "scrape_market_odds"."away_team_id" IS NULL OR "scrape_market_odds"."home_team_id" <> "scrape_market_odds"."away_team_id"

scrape_observation_history_score_basis.name: scrape_observation_history_score_basis
scrape_observation_history_score_basis.value: ("scrape_observation_history"."kind" = 'fixture' AND "scrape_observation_history"."score_basis" IS NULL) OR ("scrape_observation_history"."kind" = 'result' AND "scrape_observation_history"."score_basis" IS NOT NULL AND "scrape_observation_history"."score_basis" IN ('regular_time', 'includes_extra_time', 'unknown'))

scrape_observation_history_score_shape.name: scrape_observation_history_score_shape
scrape_observation_history_score_shape.value: "scrape_observation_history"."score" IS NULL OR (jsonb_typeof("scrape_observation_history"."score") = 'object' AND ("scrape_observation_history"."score"->>'home') ~ '^[0-9]{1,2}$' AND ("scrape_observation_history"."score"->>'away') ~ '^[0-9]{1,2}$' AND (("scrape_observation_history"."score"->>'htHome') IS NULL OR ("scrape_observation_history"."score"->>'htHome') ~ '^[0-9]{1,2}$') AND (("scrape_observation_history"."score"->>'htAway') IS NULL OR ("scrape_observation_history"."score"->>'htAway') ~ '^[0-9]{1,2}$') AND (("scrape_observation_history"."score"->>'htHome') IS NULL) = (("scrape_observation_history"."score"->>'htAway') IS NULL))

scrape_observations_unresolved_idx.name: scrape_observations_unresolved_idx
scrape_observations_unresolved_idx.where: "scrape_observations"."competition_id" IS NULL OR "scrape_observations"."home_team_id" IS NULL OR "scrape_observations"."away_team_id" IS NULL

scrape_observations_score_basis.name: scrape_observations_score_basis
scrape_observations_score_basis.value: ("scrape_observations"."kind" = 'fixture' AND "scrape_observations"."score_basis" IS NULL) OR ("scrape_observations"."kind" = 'result' AND "scrape_observations"."score_basis" IS NOT NULL AND "scrape_observations"."score_basis" IN ('regular_time', 'includes_extra_time', 'unknown'))

scrape_observations_score_shape.name: scrape_observations_score_shape
scrape_observations_score_shape.value: "scrape_observations"."score" IS NULL OR (jsonb_typeof("scrape_observations"."score") = 'object' AND ("scrape_observations"."score"->>'home') ~ '^[0-9]{1,2}$' AND ("scrape_observations"."score"->>'away') ~ '^[0-9]{1,2}$' AND (("scrape_observations"."score"->>'htHome') IS NULL OR ("scrape_observations"."score"->>'htHome') ~ '^[0-9]{1,2}$') AND (("scrape_observations"."score"->>'htAway') IS NULL OR ("scrape_observations"."score"->>'htAway') ~ '^[0-9]{1,2}$') AND (("scrape_observations"."score"->>'htHome') IS NULL) = (("scrape_observations"."score"->>'htAway') IS NULL))

scrape_observations_teams_differ.name: scrape_observations_teams_differ
scrape_observations_teams_differ.value: "scrape_observations"."home_team_id" IS NULL OR "scrape_observations"."away_team_id" IS NULL OR "scrape_observations"."home_team_id" <> "scrape_observations"."away_team_id"

scrape_raw_yield.name: scrape_raw_yield
scrape_raw_yield.value: ("scrape_raw"."records_seen" IS NULL OR "scrape_raw"."records_seen" >= 0) AND ("scrape_raw"."records_accepted" IS NULL OR "scrape_raw"."records_accepted" >= 0)

scrape_runs_api_credits.name: scrape_runs_api_credits
scrape_runs_api_credits.value: ("scrape_runs"."api_credits_spent" IS NULL OR "scrape_runs"."api_credits_spent" >= 0) AND ("scrape_runs"."api_credits_used" IS NULL OR "scrape_runs"."api_credits_used" >= 0) AND ("scrape_runs"."api_credits_remaining" IS NULL OR "scrape_runs"."api_credits_remaining" >= 0)

received_sms_parsed.name: received_sms_parsed
received_sms_parsed.value: ("received_sms"."status" = 'unparsed') = ("received_sms"."reference" IS NULL) AND ("received_sms"."reference" IS NULL) = ("received_sms"."amount" IS NULL) AND ("received_sms"."reference" IS NULL) = ("received_sms"."direction" IS NULL)

cash_operations_money_row.name: cash_operations_money_row
cash_operations_money_row.value: ("cash_operations"."kind" = 'deposit' AND "cash_operations"."payment_intent_id" IS NOT NULL AND "cash_operations"."payout_id" IS NULL) OR ("cash_operations"."kind" = 'withdrawal' AND "cash_operations"."payout_id" IS NOT NULL AND "cash_operations"."payment_intent_id" IS NULL)

cashier_shifts_closed.name: cashier_shifts_closed
cashier_shifts_closed.value: ("cashier_shifts"."status" = 'closed') = ("cashier_shifts"."closed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "cashier_shifts"."counted_cash" IS NOT NULL AND "cashier_shifts"."expected_cash" IS NOT NULL)
